targetScore.title: Target Score
targetScore.help: The score a player has to reach to win the game.

entryScore.title: Entry Score
entryScore.help: How much a player's first banked turn has to be worth before any of their points count. Set to zero to let players bank from the very first turn.

hotDice.title: Hot Dice
hotDice.help: When every die on the table has been set aside, the player gets all six back and keeps the points riding on the turn.

finalRound.title: Final Round
finalRound.help: Passing the target score opens one last round instead of ending the game at once, so everyone gets the same number of turns.

multiples.title: Four Of A Kind And Up
multiples.help: How four, five and six of a kind score against the three of a kind they are built on.

straightScore.help: What one of every face, rolled in a single throw of six dice, is worth. Set to zero to take it out of the game.

threePairsScore.help: What three pairs, rolled in a single throw of six dice, are worth. Set to zero to take them out of the game.

twoTripletsScore.help: What two triplets, rolled in a single throw of six dice, are worth. Set to zero to take them out of the game.

fourAndPairScore.help: What four of a kind alongside a pair, rolled in a single throw of six dice, is worth. Set to zero to take it out of the game.

farklePenalty.title: Farkle Penalty
farklePenalty.help: Points taken off a player who farkles several turns in a row. Set to zero for no penalty.

farklePenaltyStreak.title: Farkles In A Row
farklePenaltyStreak.help: How many turns in a row have to end in a farkle before the penalty is taken.

speed.title: Speed
speed.help: How fast the dice roll animation is played.

addedRollTime.title: Added Time
addedRollTime.help: How much time is added after each throw. Will never exceed the turn time.

sprint.title: Sprint
description: A short game to 4000, and no entry score to hold you up

greed.title: Greed
description: Every extra die doubles, and farkling three times running costs you

scorecard.entryHelp: You need at least {points} in one turn before your first bank counts. After that you can bank any amount you like.

info.holdHint: Click a die to take it out of the bowl
info.farkleLost: Farkle. You have lost all points kept and set aside this turn.
info.hotDiceHint: Every die scored, so all six come back.

description.single1: A single 1 scores on its own, alongside anything else you set aside.
description.single5: A single 5 scores on its own, alongside anything else you set aside.
description.threeOnes: Three 1s are the one triple worth a flat amount rather than a hundred times the face.
description.threeOfAKind: Three dice showing the same face, in one throw.
description.fourOrMore: Four, five or six dice showing the same face. What each extra die adds is up to the table.
description.straight: One of every face, in a single throw of all six dice.
description.threePairs: Three pairs, in a single throw of all six dice.
description.twoTriplets: Two triplets, in a single throw of all six dice.
description.fourAndPair: Four of a kind alongside a pair, in a single throw of all six dice.

status.throw: Roll all six dice to start your turn
status.choose: Roll again to add more, or bank the turn

error.selection: Every die you set aside has to be part of a scoring combination.
error.locked: That die is already set aside and cannot be moved.
error.empty: You have to set at least one scoring die aside before rolling again.
error.entry: Your first banked turn has to be worth at least {points}.

objective.title: The goal
description: The first player to **bank** the target score wins. It is usually 10,000 points.
Points are only yours once you bank them. Until then, one bad roll takes them all. This is called a **farkle**.

turn.title: Taking a turn
description: Roll all six dice, then click the ones you want to keep to take them out of the bowl. Click a die again to put it back. Every die you keep has to score.
Then roll what is left to add more, or bank what you have and pass the turn on. The fewer dice left, the likelier the next roll scores nothing.

scoring.title: What scores
description: A single 1 is worth 100 and a single 5 is worth 50. No other die scores on its own.

Three of a kind is worth 100 times its face, but three 1s are worth 1000. Four or more of a kind are worth more again. A straight, three pairs, two triplets, and four of a kind with a pair need all six dice in one roll.

farkle.title: Farkling
description: Roll no scoring dice at all and you **farkle**. The turn ends, and every point you kept or set aside during it is gone.
Knowing when to stop is the whole game. Some tables also take points off a player who farkles several turns in a row.

variations.title: House rules
description: **Hot dice**: set every die aside and you get all six back, keeping the points.
**Entry score**: your first bank has to reach it, or none of it counts.
**Final round**: once somebody passes the target, everybody else gets one last turn.
